data.name: JourneyXR
data.detailed_description:
Ever wanted to jump between worlds with the snap of your fingers? Journey is a mixed reality experience that lets you do exactly that.

Step into a universe where the boundaries between the real and the virtual dissolve. Portals open around you, revealing entirely new environments waiting to be explored. Walk through them and suddenly the space around you transforms, turning your surroundings into gateways to distant realms. The world of Journey is built from interconnected landscapes, each one leading seamlessly into another

This experience becomes even more exciting when shared. Multiple players can explore together in real time, stepping through portals, discovering new environments, and witnessing the transformation of space side by side. Whether you're guiding someone into a newly opened realm or exploring an unfamiliar world together, the sense of shared adventure is at the heart of the experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 760 / AMD Radeon R7 260x
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: Meta Quest
